findings.title: Enable secret (not enable password) is used
AAA new-model is enabled
findings.remediation: Configure 'aaa new-model' and model authentication/authorization with AAA.

findings.title: Legacy 'enable password' is not present
findings.remediation: Remove 'enable password'; it uses weak/clear storage.

findings.title: No SNMP community 'public' or 'private'
findings.remediation: Remove default SNMP communities; prefer SNMPv3 with auth+priv.

findings.title: SNMP communities are not read-write
findings.remediation: Avoid RW communities; use read-only or SNMPv3.

findings.title: Secure management plane (SSH present, Telnet VTY transport removed)
findings.detail: required configuration not found: /^ip ssh version 2/
findings.remediation: Set 'ip ssh version 2' and generate a >=2048-bit RSA key.

findings.title: VTY lines use SSH transport only (no Telnet)
findings.remediation: Set 'transport input ssh' on all VTY lines.

findings.title: Access ports have port-security or BPDU guard
findings.remediation: On edge access ports, enable PortFast + BPDU guard and/or port-security.

findings.title: Access ports have port-security or BPDU guard
findings.remediation: On edge access ports, enable PortFast + BPDU guard and/or port-security.

findings.title: Logging to a syslog server is configured
findings.remediation: Send logs to a central syslog/SIEM with 'logging host <ip>'.

findings.title: Insecure small/legacy services are disabled
findings.remediation: Disable the HTTP server (use HTTPS), and remove small-servers/finger services.

findings.title: A login/MOTD banner is present
findings.remediation: Add an authorized-use banner with 'banner login'.

findings.title: NTP authentication is enabled
findings.remediation: Enable 'ntp authenticate' and configure authentication keys.

findings.title: VTY lines have an exec-timeout
findings.remediation: Set 'exec-timeout 10 0' (or site standard) on console and VTY lines.

findings.title: Unused-looking interfaces are shut down
findings.remediation: Administratively shut interfaces that are not in use ('shutdown').
